## Load data

```{r load-rds}
# From 04_convergence.Rmd
convergence_genus_loma <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_convergence_genus_loma.rds"))
convergence_genus_away <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_convergence_genus_away.rds"))
convergence_subcl_loma <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_convergence_subcl_loma.rds"))
convergence_subcl_away <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_convergence_subcl_away.rds"))

# From 05_nmds_plots.Rmd
nmds_euc_genus_focal      <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_nmds_euc_genus_focal.rds"))
nmds_euc_genus_focal_away <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_nmds_euc_genus_focal_away.rds"))
nmds_euc_subcl_focal      <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_nmds_euc_subcl_focal.rds"))
nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "fig_nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away.rds"))
```

## Helper

```{r helpers}
# 2×2 combined figure.
# A: NMDS genus   — legend inside top-right
# B: conv genus   — legend inside top-right; y-axis labelled
# C: NMDS subcl   — no legend
# D: conv subcl   — no legend; y-axis labelled
make_combined_fig <- function(nmds_genus, conv_genus, nmds_subcl, conv_subcl) {

  # Tight legend for A (faceted NMDS — legend covers plot area)
  leg_inside_a <- theme(
    legend.position        = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.99),
    legend.justification   = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background      = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.45), colour = NA),
    legend.box             = "vertical",
    legend.spacing         = unit(0.5, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y       = unit(0.5, "mm"),
    legend.key.size        = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    legend.key.spacing.y   = unit(1, "pt"), 
    legend.text            = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title           = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold",
                                          margin = margin(b = 0, unit = "pt")),
    legend.margin          = margin(0, 0, 2, 0)
  )

  # Standard inside legend for B (convergence — plenty of white space)
  leg_inside_b <- theme(
    legend.position        = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.99),
    legend.justification   = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background      = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.75), colour = NA)
  )

  y_title <- labs(y = "Mean convergence (\u00b1 SE)")

  plot_grid(
    nmds_genus + leg_inside_a,
    conv_genus + leg_inside_b + y_title,
    nmds_subcl + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    conv_subcl + theme(legend.position = "none") + y_title,
    ncol       = 2,
    labels     = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    label_size = 11,
    align      = "hv",
    axis       = "tblr",
    rel_widths = c(2.5, 1)
  )
}
```

---

## Figure 1 — LOMA inoculum focal

Panels A & C: Euclidean NMDS centroids (genus and subclade level, LOMA inoculum focus).
Panels B & D: Euclidean distance convergence paths (LOMA source).

```{r fig1-loma-focal, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 10}    
combined_fig1 <- make_combined_fig(
  nmds_euc_genus_focal, convergence_genus_loma,
  nmds_euc_subcl_focal, convergence_subcl_loma
)

combined_fig1

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "combined_LOMA_focal_EUC_NMDS_convergence.png"),
       combined_fig1, width = 280, height = 180, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Figure 2 — Away inoculum focal

Panels A & C: Euclidean NMDS centroids (genus and subclade level, away inoculum focus).
Panels B & D: Euclidean distance convergence paths (away source).

```{r fig2-away-focal, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 10}
combined_fig2 <- make_combined_fig(
  nmds_euc_genus_focal_away, convergence_genus_away,
  nmds_euc_subcl_focal_away, convergence_subcl_away
)

combined_fig2

ggsave(file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "plots", "combined_away_focal_EUC_NMDS_convergence.png"),
       combined_fig2, width = 280, height = 180, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
